case.title: The Stolen Blueprint
case.subtitle: Operation Blue Horizon
case.brief: A confidential satellite-guidance blueprint (BLUE_HORIZON_v7.blueprint) was exfiltrated from NovaTech Industries' secure R&D server on the night of March 14. External monitoring flagged an unauthorized outbound transfer at 23:47. Four employees had access that night. One of them is the leaker. Examine the seized workstation image, recover what was deleted, and cross-reference the activity logs to identify the attacker.

priya.name: Priya Nair
priya.alibi: Claims she left the office at 18:30 and was home by 19:15. Says she never logged back in.
priya.motive: Recently passed over for a promotion. Visible frustration with management.

marcus.name: Marcus Vale
marcus.alibi: Claims he was on a 23:00 maintenance call and only touched server infrastructure, not the blueprint.
marcus.motive: Undisclosed debt. A crypto wallet was flagged in financial screening last month.

elena.name: Elena Rusakova
elena.alibi: Says she was running an overnight compliance audit and was in the office until 01:00.
elena.motive: None known — recently awarded a performance bonus.

david.name: David Okafor
david.alibi: Claims he was asleep at home. His badge shows exit at 17:45.
david.motive: Financial stress (student loans). Recently denied a raise.

files.name: BLUE_HORIZON_v7.blueprint
files.content:
=== NOVATECH INDUSTRIES — CONFIDENTIAL ===
CLASSIFICATION: TOP SECRET
PROJECT: BLUE HORIZON (Satellite Guidance Module)
VERSION: 7.0

[ENCRYPTED PAYLOAD — 48.2 MB]
Access log: last opened 2025-03-14 23:46:11 by session 'svc-maint'.

NOTE: This file was accessed outside approved window (09:00–19:00).
Outbound copy attempt detected at 23:47.
files.clue: The blueprint was opened at 23:46 under session 'svc-maint' — a service account, not a normal user.

files.content:
SERVICE ACCOUNT: svc-maint

files.clue: svc-maint credentials were never rotated and were last used from IP 10.20.4.71 — which belongs to workstation WS-RND-07.

files.content:

files.clue: Marcus Vale owns this file. It confirms he had svc-maint credentials AND an urgent need to move crypto funds before Friday.

files.name: audit_runner.sh
files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Overnight compliance audit — Elena Rusakova
echo 'Starting audit...'
nmap -sV 10.20.0.0/24 > /var/log/audit/scan_$(date +%F).log
find /secure -type f -newermt '2025-03-14 23:00' -ls >> /var/log/audit/changes.log
echo 'Audit complete.'
files.clue: Elena's audit script only READS and LOGS. It does not copy or transmit any files. Consistent with her alibi.

files.name: resume_2025.pdf
files.content:
DAVID OKAFOR — Junior Developer
Seeking new opportunities.

Skills: JavaScript, Python, basic networking.
Note: current role lacks growth. Actively interviewing.
files.clue: David is job-hunting. Motive to leave, but no evidence linking him to the blueprint or the svc-maint account.

messages.content: got access. using the maintenance account so it looks like routine work. file moves tonight.
messages.clue: Marcus admits using the maintenance account to access something. Timestamp is before the leak.

messages.content: good. blueprint only. 50k on delivery. delete everything after.
messages.clue: Buyer confirms target is the blueprint and offers 50k. Instructs deletion — explains the wiped messages.

messages.content: I'll sort the money out this weekend, I promise. Just need one more day.
messages.clue: Personal message shows financial pressure — supports motive but is not direct evidence.

messages.content: I'm disappointed about the promotion decision but I'll keep my head down and focus on my work.
messages.clue: Priya is frustrated, but the tone is professional and she logged off early. Weak motive at best.

messages.content: Thanks for the interview. I'll wait to hear back. Really hoping to move on soon.
messages.clue: David is interviewing elsewhere — motive to leave, but no link to the breach.

messages.content: done. transfer sent. wipe the chat.
messages.clue: Sent 2 minutes after the outbound transfer at 23:47. Confirms Marcus completed and reported the leak.

logs.detail: Priya Nair logged off and badge-exited the building.
logs.clue: Priya's session ended at 18:30 — she was gone hours before the breach.

logs.detail: Service account 'svc-maint' authenticated interactively from Marcus Vale's workstation.
logs.clue: The service account logged in from WS-RND-07 — Marcus Vale's machine — at 23:46.

logs.detail: Blueprint file opened under svc-maint session.
logs.clue: The blueprint was opened one second after the service login — same session.

logs.detail: 48.2 MB outbound transfer to external IP flagged by monitoring.
logs.clue: The 48.2 MB transfer (matching the blueprint size) went to an external Tor exit node.

logs.detail: svc-maint session terminated; local temp files wiped.
logs.clue: Session ended 2 minutes after transfer; temp files wiped — anti-forensics behavior.

logs.detail: Incoming crypto transfer to Marcus Vale's wallet.
logs.clue: Payment landed 25 minutes after the leak — matches the 50k offer in the recovered chat.

logs.detail: Elena's compliance audit script started; read-only operations only.
logs.clue: Elena's audit only read and logged — no copy or transfer activity.
